review_method: Authored from the invented conversations, independently of adapter summaries. English meaning is checked against original Spanish where applicable. Exact quotations below identify the supporting passages.

support.am01-s1: Hi, Nora Bell here. Is the office still on the second floor? I am outside for my appointment.
support.am01-s2: Yes, second floor, suite 204. The elevator is just past the lobby desk.
support.am01-s3: I see it now. That is all I needed, thanks.

calls.outcome: Caller deferred booking while gathering documents

support.am02-s2: My name is Evan Reed. I have never used your office. Do you take questions about a lease deposit?
support.am02-s3: The lawyer would need to decide whether that is something he can help with. We can offer an initial conversation.
support.am02-s4: I am only checking today. I want to gather my paperwork before asking for an appointment.

calls.reason: Ask if a copy is acceptable at reception

support.am03-s1: Buenos días, soy Lucía Soto. ¿Puedo entregar una copia en vez del documento original?
support.am03-s2: Para dejarlo en recepción, sí, una copia está bien. Si el abogado necesita el original, se lo dirá.
support.am03-s3: Perfecto, entonces guardaré el original en casa. Solo quería confirmar eso.

calls.outcome: Staff recorded a message without a callback time

support.am04-s1: This is Daniel Moss. I left a question about the letter I received, and I would like the lawyer to call me back.
support.am04-s3: Whether he has had a chance to read it. There is no new date on it that I can see.
support.am04-s4: I have written that in the message. I cannot give you a callback time.
support.am04-s5: That is fine. The number already on my file is the one to use.

support.am05-s1: Hello, Priya Lane calling. I received the appointment directions, but the attachment opens as a blank page.
support.am05-s2: Let me check. I can read the parking directions over the phone now: use the visitor spaces behind the building.
support.am05-s3: That helps. Could you also send me a readable copy?
support.am05-s4: Yes, I will resend the directions this afternoon.

support.am06-s2: Is this the pharmacy on Main Street?
support.am06-s3: No, this is a law office.

calls.outcome: Language question answered; caller deferred booking

support.am07-s1: Me llamo Mateo Cruz. ¿La primera conversación puede ser en español? Todavía no quiero reservar.
support.am07-s2: Podemos recibir su consulta en español. Antes de fijar una cita, necesitamos saber de qué se trata.
support.am07-s3: Entiendo. Voy a hablar con mi hermana primero; ella tiene los papeles. Hoy solo quería preguntar por el idioma.

calls.outcome: Receipt logged at 10:15, contents review unconfirmed

support.am08-s1: Ruth Ellis here. I am checking that you received the envelope I dropped off this morning.
support.am08-s2: I have the reception log in front of me. It shows an envelope from Ruth Ellis received at ten fifteen.
support.am08-s3: Great. I was not asking whether anyone had reviewed it, just whether it arrived.
support.am08-s4: Yes, receipt is logged. I cannot tell you whether it has been reviewed.

calls.suggestion: Consider identifying interrupted inquiry; no assignment

support.am09-s1: I am calling about the meeting. I thought it was—
support.am09-s2: Could you give me your name and which meeting you mean?

calls.outcome: Staff stated July 22 at four; caller corrected calendar

support.am10-s1: Hi, it is Owen Park. The reminder says four, but my calendar says three. What time is my appointment?
support.am10-s2: I am looking at the appointment list. Your appointment is at four on July twenty-second.
support.am10-s3: July twenty-second at four. I have corrected my calendar now.
